ns2:section.sectionText: This section for seniors in FSHN only. Outside majors should register for section A. All registrants must be 21 years of age or older. Valid Driver license/State ID/USA Passport will be checked at every class meeting. Registration beyond the set 20 seat limit will not be allowed. If you get a 'course full' error message and want to be added to a wait list for this class, go to www.fshn.illinois.edu and click on Undergraduate then Course Wait List. Wait lists will not open until one week before classes start in August. Until that time, it is up to you to continue to check the status of this course to see if a seat has become available for you.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Restricted to students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition department.
